cards.name: Summer Academy
cards.description: Students participate in six weeks of reading and math instruction, project-based STEM learning, swimming lessons, arts activities, gardening, and field trips. The program also includes social and emotional learning.

financial_aid.text: 100% of students qualify for free and reduced lunches; and attend Horizons on a tuition-free basis

lunch.text: Every Horizons student receives a minimum of two meals and one snack daily

transportation.text: We commit to providing a high-quality and accessible program experience through round-trip transportation, meals (breakfast, lunch, and snacks) to fuel our students’ day, and all teaching and learning supplies students need to fully participate.

cards.review_notes: The Summer Academy page says grades K–8, while the October 1, 2026 official Summer LABS blog search result explicitly describes the summer program as serving rising 1st through 9th graders. The latter is used for the 2026 grade range; the blog could not be read beyond its search result. The school’s official Horizons page also says students join after kindergarten and return through Grade 9. Exact summer dates, daily hours, and enrollment deadlines were not found.
